## {{< iconify octicon:code-24 >}} Open Source Contributions

::: {.highlight}

Creator of the __*[Quarto Extensions Directory](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-extensions/)*__, __*[Quarto Wizard](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard)*__ Visual Studio Code extension, and __*[Awesome Quarto](https://github.com/mcanouil/awesome-quarto)*__ repository, with __*30+ Quarto extensions*__ developed.

:::

[M]{.drop-cap}y Quarto and Typst work covers Lua filters and shortcodes, HTML, Reveal.js, and Typst formats, plus [Gribouille](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille), a grammar of graphics for Typst.
On the R side I have written packages for genomics quality control, statistical testing, and visualisation ([NACHO](https://github.com/mcanouil/NACHO), [insane](https://github.com/mcanouil/insane), [MiSTr](https://github.com/mcanouil/MiSTr), [snpEnrichment](https://github.com/mcanouil/snpEnrichment)), and some that are far less useful but much more entertaining ([ggpacman](https://github.com/mcanouil/ggpacman)).
